summary: Maroon pixels reachable through orange background from the green square with red center are collected and fill the green square from top-left, sorted by distance.
src: maroon pixels reachable from green square through orange background s
dst: green square with red center d
match_cond: s is connected to d via orange pixels (not blocked by magenta walls)
path: collect s pixels sorted by distance to d, fill d.interior from top-left in row-major order
trajectory: s disappears from original position, appears at d.interior positions
